allocations.rationale: Directly resolves the fundamental clinical divergence between infantile/childhood LoF leukodystrophy and adult-onset cysteine-missense stroke presentations, providing exact cohort frequencies, onset ages, and HPO phenotypes.

Resolves the critical neuroimaging conflict between anterior temporal pole involvement versus strict sparing across primary cohorts (Ouskri, Stellingwerff, Tasharrofi) to establish an essential diagnostic discriminator.
